name: Canberra Deep Space Communication Complex
description: The Australian station of NASA's Deep Space Network at Tidbinbilla, about 20 km from Canberra, managed by CSIRO for JPL.
highlights: Opened on 19 March 1965 by Prime Minister Robert Menzies.
Its 70 m antenna DSS-43 (enlarged from 64 m in 1987) is the only antenna on Earth that can send commands to Voyager 2.
It has five large deep space stations and also uses the Parkes radio telescope for extra receiving capacity.
